exclusions.reason: Execution sandbox hid CPU metadata; PyTorch reported NO AVX and cpuinfo/NNPACK warnings. Quality tensors are retained and compared; these timings are excluded. All later timings used normal CPU-discovery visibility.

Late legacy sample jumped to 8492 ms and following arms stayed slow. A post-run read-only snapshot found four unrelated tesseract workers at 164-189% CPU each while the container quota was 8 CPUs. Timing arms are retained but excluded; no unrelated process was changed.
exclusions.causality_limit: CPU contention was directly observed after the timing group, not continuously traced throughout it. No exact attribution or uncontended speedup is inferred from these arms.
exclusions.memory_note: Container memory includes file cache; this value is not any model's process RSS.

orchestration_failures.error: Legacy original256 dumper emitted PNG and NPY, without input.rgb8/fill-mask.u8; wrapper initially expected raw files.
orchestration_failures.resolution: Derived exact frozen fixture bytes and checked equality with original PNG bytes; saved independent derivation receipt. No original numerical data changed.

orchestration_failures.error: Combined stdout/stderr inserted a profile diagnostic into one buffered JSON stage line.
orchestration_failures.resolution: Preserve this entire attempt and rerun native comparator with separate stdout/stderr streams. No original recapture or budget change.

artifact_policy: Original reference tensors and failed-attempt evidence retained. Passing duplicate native intermediate arrays were hashed, compared and pruned; final raw output, final RGB, all numerical reports, command logs and receipts remain retained.
